newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Elbit wins Italian air force contract.
newsitem.headline: Elbit wins Italian air force contract.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Systems Ltd said on Wednesday it had won a $25 million contract to supply the Italian air force with its OPHER guided-weapon systems.
Elbit said it would supply the equipment over three years and expected the contract to lead to additional orders.
"This contract signifies an important milestone for Elbit Systems as it constitutes the entry of the company into the Italian defence market," Elbit president Joseph Ackerman said in a statement.

"We anticipate that this programme will lead to expanding Elbit Systems' relations with the Italian air force, as well as enhancing prospective OPHER sales to additional NATO countries and other customers," he said.

Developed by Elbit, the OPHER system is designed to make precision strikes of surface targets by aircraft. After releasing the weapon in the general direction of the target, OPHER independently guides it by targetting the thermal image of the target.
